But the run's OWN clause (a) (anneal-gate latch + coef ramp 3->0) never had a chance: bc_anchor_anneal/gate_pass=0 in all 11 in-training checks, coef pinned at 3.0 throughout, auto-stopped by the canary regression guard at 5.5M/8M (walk_fwd 2/2->0/2) with reward still rising (quarters 211->1250). Evidence: the in-training ignition-gate ASSAY had a real code bug, not a policy or distribution problem -- root-caused this cycle via a standalone GPU repro (, MjxShardedVecEnv, same cfg as this run, zero-action policy): train_ppo_mjx._BcAnchorAnnealGateCb._build() constructs the assay env and NEVER isolates its goal generator to pure walk (unlike the main training venv's own post-construction set_goal_mix(args.goal_mix) call, and unlike goal.walk_pure's construction-time isolation) -- so every assay episode silently drew from config.yaml's default multi-mode mixture (p_hold=0.10/p_lean=0.15/p_track=0.15/p_unload=0.20/p_raise=0.15/p_rise=0.35 PLUS this task's own p_walk=0.70 default, walk ~39% of draws not 100%). A non-walk draw has no .vx trajectory, so cmd_dist/cmd_prog_m never accumulate and cmd_prog_frac reads nan for that episode regardless of falls -- aggregate_walk_probe's plain-mean (by design, matches eval_task's own nan rules) poisons the WHOLE round to nan from a single such episode, so the ignition gate could never latch even on a genuinely clean round (confirmed: several rounds read early_term_rate=0.00 with prog=nan). Why (not a FAIL on the policy): both -reseed8m held-out reads (this one + the s1 twin) show real, six-leg, zero-fall walking under the still-strong anchor at/near the ignition bar -- the mechanism's own instrumentation was blind to that, not the policy. Fixed this cycle: _build() now forces a full pure-walk isolation (zero every p_<mode>, then p_walk=1.0, via the VecEnv-safe set_goal_mix hook -- the same isolation eval_checkpoint.py's per-mode forcing and goal.walk_pure both already use), verified end-to-end on a live GPU repro (0/8 nan across 3 reseeded rounds, vs 5-6/8 nan before the fix), 2 new regression tests (test_walkcurr_mjx.py), 137+21 existing tests green, snapshot exp/bc-anchor-anneal-goalmix-fix (landed via a concurrent cycle's snapshot sweep, confirmed pushed).
